input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law and Section 28.2 gives the state and federal courts in New York County exclusive jurisdiction, with only a customary carve-out permitting temporary injunctive relief elsewhere — which does not defeat the exclusive merits forum. No arbitration provision appears anywhere in the document. This meets the preferred position (New York law and exclusive New York County courts); the pre-suit executive escalation in 28.3 does not displace the forum and expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings. No redline required.
